question:
A series $LCR$ circuit is used in a lab to demonstrate resonance. The circuit shows maximum current at $f_0=50\,\text{Hz}$. The current becomes $\dfrac{I_{\max}}{\sqrt{2}}$ at $f_1=45\,\text{Hz}$ and $f_2=55\,\text{Hz}$. The inductor used has $L=0.50\,\text{H}$.

A student concludes: "Since the half-power frequencies are symmetric about $f_0$, the circuit must have a very high quality factor and very small resistance."</br>

Evaluate this conclusion by calculating the resistance $R$ and the quality factor $Q$.
